omitted: OpenRouter proxies several hundred models from dozens of upstream providers; exhaustive coverage is explicitly out of scope for this registry, which aims at a well-chosen representative set instead. This snapshot includes 4 well-known first-party models (one each proxying OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, plus one open-weight Meta model) fetched from their individual OpenRouter model pages (https://openrouter.ai/<slug>), which rendered reliably; the aggregate listing pages (https://openrouter.ai/models, https://openrouter.ai/models?order=top-weekly) and the bulk JSON API (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models) did not render usable per-model pricing consistently via automated fetch during this pass and were not used as the source of record for any entry above.

No cachedInput or batchMultiplier is recorded for any OpenRouter entry: OpenRouter's per-model pages describe an aggregate "60-80% cheaper after prompt caching" claim, not a specific per-model cached-token rate, so nothing was recorded rather than guessing a number from that range.

The anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 entry above carried an explicit uncertainty flag from 2026-08-05: its observed rate matched Anthropic's own introductory rate rather than the standard rate then scheduled for 2026-09-01. Withdrawn on 2026-09-07 - Anthropic cancelled that increase, so the observed rate is the standard rate. The entry's notes record why the flag existed and why it went.

Still four models by design, not OpenRouter's full proxy catalogue. Models added elsewhere in this pass (openai/gpt-6-astra, google/gemini-3.8-flash and the like) were not looked up on OpenRouter, so none is recorded here - a per-slug fetch each, deferred rather than guessed from the first-party rate.
